fact: At a training in Niamey on 28 to 30 May 2024 the ANMC presented the national standards body set up by decree 2019-409 of 26 July 2019 under law 2002-028, and a repertory of 216 Nigerien standards by sector (agri-food 54, chemicals 5, water and environment 6, construction materials 5, fundamental 10, quality management 45, electrotechnical 72, technical regulations 19) with no information technology or data sector.
title: Normalisation et procédure d'élaboration des normes de qualité
publisher: ANMC (Agence Nigérienne de Normalisation, de Métrologie et de Certification), Union européenne SustLives project
